cues: A carpenter locates wall studs, marks level intervals, and secures supports before adding boards for a home library.
During cataloging, staff assign each new volume a call number that determines its place among related subjects.
After a library program, volunteers return picture books to low display rows so young visitors can choose independently.
A reader checks spine labels against a printed catalog, correcting misplaced titles before the next borrowing session.
For an author event, staff group featured novels together and leave neighboring titles visible for browsing.
When a collection grows, a homeowner rearranges the study’s reading corner to keep frequently consulted works accessible.
